response.query: What response-bias and data-quality checks (social desirability scales, attention items, time-to-complete thresholds) should be included to detect biased or careless responses?
response.answer: To detect biased or careless responses, use instructed response items, attention checks, and measure response time. These methods help identify inattentive respondents.
